Frequently Asked Questions

Does RethinkBH have solutions for solo practitioners?

Yes, RethinkBH offers solutions tailored for solo practitioners. They provide practice management and clinical tools that can help streamline operations, manage billing, and organize client data efficiently. Their platform is designed to be user-friendly and scalable, which makes it suitable for individual practitioners aiming to optimize their practice.

Does RethinkBH support multi-location practices?

Yes, RethinkBH supports multi-location practices. The platform is designed to help manage various aspects of behavioral health practices across multiple locations. It offers features such as centralized scheduling, billing, reporting, and even role permissions to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

How user-friendly is RethinkBH for clinicians and admin staff?

RethinkBH is designed for ease of use, with an intuitive interface, customizable workflows, and comprehensive tools for scheduling, billing, and data collection. Training resources and customer support help staff get up to speed quickly.

Is RethinkBH HIPAA compliant?

Yes, RethinkBH is fully HIPAA compliant and is designed to meet the strict security and privacy standards required to protect sensitive health information. Additionally, the platform is equipped to meet state-specific Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) standards.

How quickly can my practice be set up on RethinkBH?

The setup time for RethinkBH can vary depending on several factors, including the size of your practice and specific requirements. However, generally speaking, practices can often be up and running within a few weeks. RethinkBH typically offers support and resources to facilitate a smooth transition, so it’s best to contact our customer service for a more precise timeline tailored to your practice’s needs.

How much does RethinkBH cost?

Pricing varies depending on the number of users, modules, and services. Reach out for a personalized demo and pricing plan.

What is the pricing structure for RethinkBH?

RethinkBH offers customized pricing based on your organization’s size and needs. Contact our team for a tailored quote.
